description: NX-Shell dependency manifest - tracks all external dependencies with pinned versions

imgui.description: Dear ImGui - immediate mode GUI library

libnsbmp.structure: Source in src/libnsbmp.c, header in include/libnsbmp.h

stb.description: stb single-file public domain libraries (for stb_image.h)

libusbhsfs.description: USB filesystem support library (pre-built release with lwext4 and ntfs-3g)

nspmini.description: Minimal NSP installation library for Nintendo Switch

update_instructions.git_dependencies: Update version/commit in this file (dependencies.json), then clean rebuild. CMake reads from here.
update_instructions.docker_image: Update docker_tag in system_packages.devkitpro, then update build.yml container image reference
update_instructions.system_packages: Run 'dkp-pacman -Syu' locally, or update docker_tag to a newer image

notes: This file is the SINGLE SOURCE OF TRUTH for dependency versions
CMake reads this file at configure time to set FetchContent tags and compile definitions
The About screen displays versions directly from this file via CMake definitions
To update: modify version/commit here, delete build/, reconfigure
